svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 mock-up: export result and setup sheet
svg.text: 13 · Export result (77a): Status, Files, Run instructions (closed); Save setup sheet… Right: the setup sheet (77b), an HTML page printed from the browser.
Before program 1: Fit T1 6.35 mm end mill; set work zero X, Y and Z.
Before program 2: Change to T2 3.175 mm end mill; set Z zero, keep X and Y.
Before program 3: Change to T3 90° V-bit; set Z zero, keep X and Y.
This program does not change the tool length offset (G43.1).
If you used G51 on this controller, soft-reset it first.
Run instructions shown open here; the sheet opens with them closed.
T1 · 6.35 mm end mill · IDC Woodcraft DC-14 · 2 flutes
Fit T1 and set work zero X, Y and Z.
T2 · 3.175 mm end mill · IDC Woodcraft UC-18 · 2 flutes
Change to T2, set Z zero. Keep X and Y.
Change to T3, set Z zero. Keep X and Y.
• This program does not change the tool length offset (G43.1).
• Warning tool_change_avoidable: T2 is used by two non-adjacent operations.
